_doc: Machine-readable training readiness (docs/FINAL_COMPUTE_READINESS.md, docs/TRAINING_START_CHECKLIST.md). The orchestrator (scripts/orchestrate_training.py preflight, .github/workflows/train-orchestrator.yml) and trainers/train.py refuse to bundle or launch anything unless verdict == GO and every condition in scope is true. `conditions` lists ONLY blockers outside the code (category GPU / DATA / EXTERNAL_POLICY); internal CODE consistency is not a condition here: preflight recomputes it on every call (trainers/requirements.internal_consistency + datasets/mix.check_config over the real configs) and reports any finding as 'CODE: ...'. Only the owner changes this file, in a reviewed commit, after every condition is true with evidence.

inhouse_speaker_encoders_trained.note: training them needs the GPU and the verified data

arabic_consented_corpus_available.note: consented Arabic recordings with all five commercial scopes (datasets/arabic_import.py); English-only scope does not need it and is labelled ARABIC_NOT_VERIFIED

android_runtime_privacy_on_device.note: owner gate: needs a physical Android device; not a code task
